mathematical_scope: Unramified, fixed-source maps of tridegree (2,2,2) from the projective line to the product of three projective lines, over algebraically closed fields in all characteristics.
scientific_integrity: A mathematical proof and standalone exact computational witness tests are supplied; no independent review, priority certification, or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Does not include ramified maps or closures of their normal splitting strata.
Does not classify other tridegrees or embeddings modulo reparametrization.
Odd-characteristic smoothness and irreducibility are asserted only inside the unramified map locus.
Earlier equivalent calculations under alternative presentations remain possible.
title: Collinear ramification divisors and a characteristic-two collapse of normal-bundle splitting
